title: A Inventory for the Language
author: S. M. Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Sandoval, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
